tools.desc: Rental market statistics by ZIP, city, or county: median, average, percentiles, min/max rent, and price distributions.
Nearby rental comps for any address. See what similar properties rented for to estimate fair market rent.
Year-over-year rent growth, monthly trends, and vacancy metrics. Compare multiple cities to find where rents are rising fastest.
Most active buyers in any geography ranked by acquisition count. Identify who is aggressively acquiring in your target market.
Deep investor profile: portfolio strategy, geographic focus, flip vs. hold ratio, related LLCs, and financing patterns. Covers ~50 mega-institutional buyers.
Track an investor’s acquisition velocity over time. Spot portfolio ramp-ups and strategic pivots month by month.
Match a property to its most likely buyers based on their acquisition patterns in the same area. Built for sellers, wholesalers, and agents.
Quick top-10 buyers in an MSA with optional city and date filters. A fast on-ramp to any market.
Phone numbers, email addresses, and principal names for any buyer entity. Unlock verified contact data for direct investor outreach.
Institutional REITs and PE funds ranked by portfolio size in a location: Invitation Homes, Progress Residential, FirstKey, and more.
Screen and rank ZIP codes by gross yield, home value, rent, income, population, and institutional ownership. Your starting point for market selection.
Deep-dive investment metrics for a single ZIP: demographics, transaction volume, top buyers, rental stats, and value trends.
Browse individual investor purchases in an MSA with cash-vs-financed and corporate-vs-individual breakdowns. See each buyer’s total portfolio size.
Flip profitability distributions: hold time ranges and gross margin ranges by market. Spot the most profitable flip corridors.
Individual flip transactions with buy/sell prices, hold time, and profit. Filter by flipper name (e.g., Opendoor) for iBuyer margin analysis.
Quick snapshot: total transaction count plus top 10 buyers in any geography. A lightweight preview before drilling deeper.
Monthly investor transaction volume trends by MSA. Track how investor appetite is shifting over time.
Monthly flip volume trends by MSA. See whether flip activity is accelerating or cooling in your markets.
Largest property owners in an MSA ranked by total holdings. Includes both institutional and individual portfolios.
Latest Redfin snapshot for a ZIP or city: median sale price, days on market, active inventory, and homes sold.
Price, DOM, and inventory trends over time for a ZIP. Chart where a market has been and where it’s heading.
Side-by-side comparison of 2+ markets on price, DOM, inventory, and sale-to-list ratio. Make apples-to-apples market decisions.
Rank ZIPs in a metro by Redfin metrics: median price, DOM, inventory, price growth, homes sold, and sale-to-list.
Rental pricing with 25th/50th/75th percentiles and property type breakdown. Precision rent data.
Market-level and acquisition-specific rental yield analysis. Know your cap rate before you underwrite.
Rank ZIPs by rental metrics: median rent, rent growth, vacancy, and yield. Find the best rental markets at a glance.
ZIP-level investor activity breakdown: cash purchase %, corporate buyer %, flip volume, and ownership concentration.
Census demographics, housing stock composition, median income, education levels, and age distribution for any ZIP.
Home Value Index (HVI) and Rental Value Index (RVI) trends over time. Track long-term value and rent appreciation.
Build targeted borrower lists with advanced filters: loan count, type (bridge/DSCR), geography, contact availability, lender include/exclude, and maturity dates.
Full borrower profile: loan history, lender relationships, geographic footprint, contact info, and bridge vs. DSCR breakdown.
Rank borrowers by loan count and volume with period-over-period growth metrics. Spot who’s scaling up or winding down.
Nationwide leaderboard of the largest private lending borrowers by total loan volume. Filter by state.
Individual loan records for a borrower: lender, amount, property, term, maturity, and outstanding status. Filter to active loans or by maturity window.
Phone, email, and principal/owner names for borrowers. Enriched from commercial sources with quality flags for outreach readiness.

Borrowers recently acquired from competing lenders. See who switched and from whom: a direct pipeline for competitive displacement.
Borrowers who stopped borrowing from a specific lender. Identify churn patterns and win-back opportunities.
Rank private lenders by dollar volume originated with state and MSA filters. The definitive market share analysis tool.
Rank lenders nationwide by loan count. Filter by loan type and date range for portfolio or bridge-specific leaderboards.
List all borrowers of a specific lender with loan counts and volumes. Map a competitor’s entire client base.
Individual loan records originated by a lender: borrower, amount, property, term, maturity, and pre-foreclosure flags.
Where a lender’s borrowers went after switching. Track churn flow to see which competitors are poaching your clients.
Note buyers a lender assigns or sells loans to. Map the secondary market flow for any originator.
Where new borrowers came from: which lenders fed your growth. Reverse-engineer your acquisition funnel.
Lender overlap analysis â which other lenders a lender’s borrowers also use. Identify cross-selling and competitive displacement opportunities.
Nationwide private lending trends: monthly, quarterly, or yearly volume with loan type breakdowns, seasonal patterns, and rolling averages.
Market-wide summary: total loans, volume, unique lenders and borrowers, plus distributions by geography, type, and land use.
Rank MSAs by total lending activity. Find where capital is flowing fastest in private real estate lending.
Find private loans originated near any address. See who’s lending in the neighborhood and at what terms.
Full private lending history for a specific property: every loan on record with lender, amount, and dates.
Currently outstanding (not yet paid off) private loans by MSA or state. Identify the active loan book in any metro or state.
Foreclosures, defaults, and adverse events tied to borrowers. Identify credit risk and distress patterns across portfolios.
Search for a person or entity by name across private lending records. Find all associated loans and borrowing entities.
Person entity network search: find principals behind LLCs and trace entity relationships in lending data.
Visual entity graph connecting a person to their LLCs, loans, and contacts. Map the full corporate structure of any borrower.
Search note buyers and loan purchasers in the secondary market. Find who’s buying loan paper and at what scale.
Which lenders a note buyer acquires loans from. Map the purchase relationships in loan trading.
Individual loan-level assignment records: see exactly which loans changed hands, when, and between whom.

Manage your subscription: change plans, update payment, view invoices, or cancel via account portal.
View current list pricing and discuss the right setup for your team.

api_or_mcp.read_write: Read-only for market, buyer and lender data. The only writes are document_upload / document_delete (user's own credit-policy documents, max 10). No CRM, list or pipeline writes found.
